prompt:
Paint ONE place into this tile of a painted grand-strategy map. The input is the finished map around the place, seen straight down; the place stands at the exact CENTRE of the image.

The place: Hoàng Vân Thành, city. Paint it as a walled city: a rectangular wall with gate towers, dense grey-tile roofs inside, a central tower or palace, a market square, suburbs along the roads outside the walls.
How it looks: A broad walled city on the river where the rice plain lies flattest, crowned inside its walls by a ring of tall round granaries capped in yellow-glazed tile. At harvest a haze of rice chaff hangs over the roofs and turns gold in the low sun, which gives the city its name. Grain barges crowd the river quay below the granary gates.
Art brief: A broad, low walled city miniature on flat green-gold rice plain beside a river: rectangular grey walls, grey-tile roofs, and inside them a ring of tall round brick granaries with conical yellow-glazed tile caps, the signature and tallest element. A pale golden haze of chaff hanging low over the roofs; a river quay with a few grain barges at the base. Warm golden-hour light from the top left makes the yellow caps glow. No text, no figures larger than specks, nothing outside the footprint.

Rules:
- Paint the place as a small, finely detailed miniature, as if a model-maker had built it into this painted relief: seen from above at a gentle angle so roofs, walls and towers read clearly, its base sitting naturally on the terrain that is there (follow the slopes, the shore, the river).
- Keep it centred and compact: the whole place fits inside a circle about 22 % of the image width across the centre. Short roads or paths may lead out of it.
- Match the map exactly: the same golden-hour light from the TOP LEFT with soft shadows to the bottom right, the same painterly style, colours and level of detail as the surrounding terrain; the building scale fits the trees and hills around it.
- Leave everything outside that central circle exactly as it is in the input.
- Never: text, labels, banners with writing, flags with symbols, people larger than specks, a frame, a vignette, clouds over the place.
